items.title: X repost from @laurogeitabat: Today, I made a comment on @CanalplusF1 regarding Zak Brown’s comments about Oscar Piastri duri…
items.title_zh: X 转帖 @laurogeitabat：今天，我在 @CanalplusF1 上就 Zak Brown 昨天在 @F1 TV 采访中关于 Oscar Piastri 的言论发表了评论，我当时也在场。我完全误解了他的话，为此道歉。我知道对 Zak 和整个 McLaren 车队来说，尊重他们的车手、公平平等地对待他们有多重要。McLaren 今天拥有最快的赛车，只是在 VSC 上运气不好。我相信 Lando 和 Oscar 在 Baku 都会再次有机会争夺胜利。
items.summary: Today, I made a comment on @CanalplusF1 regarding Zak Brown’s comments about Oscar Piastri during an interview yesterday on @F1 TV, which I was part of. I completely misunderstood his words and want to apologise for that. I know how important it is to Zak and the entire McLaren team to respect their drivers and treat them fairly and equally. McLaren had the fastest car today and were unlucky with the VSC. I’m sure both Lando and Oscar will have another chance to fight for the win in Baku.
items.summary_zh: 今天，我在 @CanalplusF1 上就 Zak Brown 昨天在 @F1 TV 采访中关于 Oscar Piastri 的言论发表了评论，我当时也在场。我完全误解了他的话，为此道歉。我知道对 Zak 和整个 McLaren 车队来说，尊重他们的车手、公平平等地对待他们有多重要。McLaren 今天拥有最快的赛车，只是在 VSC 上运气不好。我相信 Lando 和 Oscar 在 Baku 都会再次有机会争夺胜利。

items.title_zh: X 发帖 @laurogeitabat：关于排位赛是否让他处于不利位置：“主要还是排位赛的问题，第1圈也不理想，整场比赛都带着损伤。我尽可能多地学习，以便更好地发挥赛车性能以及我的驾驶方式。希望我们已经为今年剩下的比赛学到了一些东西。”
items.summary: on whether quali put him in the backfoot: "it was mostly down to quali, also lap1 was not ideal, having damage the whole race. i tried to learn as much as i could to get more out of the car and the way i drive it. hopefully we've learnt a few things for the rest of the year." https://t.co/1PvET1FnfG
items.summary_zh: 关于排位赛是否让他处于不利位置：“主要还是排位赛的问题，第1圈也不理想，整场比赛都带着损伤。我尽可能多地学习，以便更好地发挥赛车性能以及我的驾驶方式。希望我们已经为今年剩下的比赛学到了一些东西。”

items.title: X post from @oscarsspiastree: Q: was it just the case of not getting things in the right weekend for quali and leaves you on…
items.title_zh: X 发帖 @oscarsspiastree：问：是不是排位赛没能在合适的周末发挥出来，导致你今天处于被动？"差不多吧。我的意思是，我觉得主要还是排位赛的问题。另外第一圈也远不理想。整场比赛都带着损伤。那样确实很难，但今天我尽量多学习，从赛车和我驾驶它的方式中榨取更多，希望我们为今年剩下的比赛学到了一些东西。"
items.summary: Q: was it just the case of not getting things in the right weekend for quali and leaves you on the back foot for today? "Pretty much. I mean, I think it was mostly down to qualifying. I think also lap 1 was far from ideal. Having damage for the whole race. It was tough like that but today I just tried to learn as much as I could to get more out of the car and the way I drive it so hopefully we've learnt a few things for the rest of the year"

items.title_zh: X 发帖 @oscarsspiastree：问：跟我们总结一下你在这场比赛后的心情。"显然从第一圈开始就非常非常痛苦，从那时起我几乎无能为力。VSC的时机对我们来说肯定不理想，毕竟我们是用硬胎起步的。那只是一个艰难的下午。"
items.summary: Q: Sum up your emotions for us after that one "It was pretty, pretty painful obviously from lap 1 and not much I really could've done from there. the timing of the VSC was certainly not ideal for us, starting on the hard. it was just a difficult afternoon." https://t.co/6zGonKmBQM
items.summary_zh: 问：跟我们总结一下你在这场比赛后的心情。"显然从第一圈开始就非常非常痛苦，从那时起我几乎无能为力。VSC的时机对我们来说肯定不理想，毕竟我们是用硬胎起步的。那只是一个艰难的下午。"
